thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired for service `inference-prod` -> rotation `infra-night` (high) — triggered by alert `errors.rate` from monitoring (count 120 in 5m). Incident link: https://pd.example/INC12345

maria: saw this. pages are going to infra-night but infra-night is the legacy rota — that team doesn't own inference-prod. looks like a binding mismatch after last week's schedule import.

chris: acked in PD. I'm on it. what is the customer impact?

incident-bot: pd-admin acknowledged the incident at 2024-05-06T01:07:12Z. escalation still on.

sam: quick context — we rolled a schedule import for oncall-sync yesterday that added a shadow schedule for infra-night (for contractors). the import accidentally created a binding that routes `inference-prod` alerts to that shadow rota when time-window overlaps.

olivia: customer-facing metric: we see 502 spikes from the inference API starting 00:55 UTC, errors up ~8% and ~3 customer sessions dropped. backend logs show repeated kv-cache misses + OOM-ish traces on a small subset of hosts. might be unrelated but pages are noisy.

maria: plan: 1) silence PD escalation for `inference-prod` (temporary) 2) remap service binding to `inference-platform-oncall` 3) failover traffic to `inference-prod-failover` pool if needed. doing 1->2 now. tagging this as P1 mitigation.

chris: please paste the exact PD commands/snippets so I can run them from my workstation.

maria: commands I'm running:
```
# silence the escalation for 30m
pd api /incidents/INC12345/notes "Silencing escalations while we rebind service"
# rebind service via infra tool
infra tool pd-service update-binding --service inference-prod --rotation inference-platform-oncall
```

oncall-bot: Rebind request accepted by infra tool. Binding update queued (job 9876).

pd-admin: confirmed I see the silence in PD and the binding change in progress. will watch for new pages.

chris: binding applied. sending test alert (low severity) to validate routing.

incident-bot: test alert delivered to `inference-platform-oncall` at 01:15 UTC. acknowledged by chris.

maria: monitoring — paging has stopped. still seeing client errors but fewer spikes. I'm kicking failover now for a small subset (5%) to reduce pressure while we investigate root cause.

sam: noted. please annotate which hosts were moved and the time range. we need correlation for postmortem.

maria: failover command: `infra tool traffic-shift --from inference-prod --to inference-prod-failover --pct 5 --note "mitigate spike"`

olivia: visible reduction in 502s on shifted cohorts. customer impact contained. informing support to send a brief note to affected customers.

josh: from PM side we need an incident summary and a decision on whether to roll back the oncall-sync import. also want an immediate action for schedule-import pipeline to add a schema validation step.

maria: agreed. immediate actions: add a validation to prevent creating bindings that match on aggregate windows; add a canary step that verifies service->rotation bindings post-import. I'll own the follow-up.

pd-admin: recorded an override to prevent automatic escalation for the legacy `infra-night` rota while we sort this out.

chris: handing off to night shift — i'm leaving notes in the incident doc and marking for oncall-handoff. @oncall-bot please create a handoff for 02:00 UTC to `infra-night` backup with context.

oncall-bot: Handoff created: INC12345 — remediation in progress. next oncall: infra-svc-night.

maria: final note for now — root cause hypothesis: schedule-import tool allowed a duplicate binding to be created when contractor shadow schedules overlapped with primary rotations. impact: misrouted pages + delayed response from correct owners leading to increased customer error exposure.

josh: thanks. we'll treat this as a high-priority postmortem with follow-ups: roll back bad imports where detected, add validation + canary for schedule imports, and run a PD routing audit to catch any other services with overlapping bindings.

olivia: support update drafted and queued. ops contact list attached in the incident doc.

maria: leaving the incident open for post-incident validation. will update thread with the final RCA and action items. good teamwork. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated (pages silenced and binding fixed). Next steps: RCA doc, postmortem meeting invite, and schedule-import safe-checks.
